html_source: Detail of a 1920 Bartholomew map showing the southeastern part of Dublin, with the National Maternity Hospital at the south end of Holles Street (blue arrow), Burke's pub at the north (purple arrow), and Sandymount Strand (where Bloom was last seen in Nausicaa) at the far right.
